presets.label: Is this AI?
presets.trend: The "is this real?" clips: phone footage nobody can call
presets.prompt: Handheld iPhone footage, photorealistic, natural shaky camera, real light and real people in the background, no text: {idea}

presets.label: Street interview
presets.trend: AI street interviews with a punchline, with real voice
presets.prompt: Vertical street interview on a busy city sidewalk, handheld mic in frame, real city noise, documentary look. The person answers in one short funny line about: {idea}

presets.label: Pet reacts
presets.trend: Animals doing human jobs: the most shared AI genre
presets.prompt: Ultra realistic phone video, real fur detail, natural motion, warm home light: a pet reacts like a person to {idea}

presets.label: Coin logo ideas
presets.trend: What coin launchers ask for first: four logo routes at once
presets.prompt: A 2x2 grid of four distinct professional coin logo concepts (flat vector, bold mascot, neon geometric, gold embossed), each a clean round token emblem with its ticker under it, dark background, crisp edges. The coin: {idea}

presets.label: Hotel lobby booth
presets.trend: TikTok: pets and friends dropped into a lobby booth
presets.prompt: Vertical phone video, viral "hotel lobby" format: a cool cat in tiny gold sunglasses sits in a velvet booth of a fancy hotel lobby at night, turns to camera and nods to the beat, lounge music. Theme: {idea}

presets.label: Faceless explainer
presets.trend: Faceless AI channels: one consistent avatar, no face on camera
presets.prompt: Vertical faceless explainer video: a sleek glowing green robot cat in a dark studio points at a floating neon chart, camera pushes in, cinematic. About: {idea}

presets.label: AI vs handmade
presets.trend: TikTok split screens set to "Dame Hombro"
presets.prompt: Vertical 9:16 split screen, viral "AI vs HANDMADE": left a glossy AI render, right the same thing made by hand on a messy desk, bold caption bar. Subject: {idea}

presets.label: AI will replace you
presets.trend: Reels: the polished AI demo vs messy real life
presets.prompt: Vertical 9:16 meme photo, "AI will replace you": top half a flawless AI demo captioned "AI DEMO", bottom half the messy real version captioned "REAL LIFE". Subject: {idea}
